verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a broad public API surface. It covers connected accounts, card issuing and authorization controls, the Card Expenses and Bills APIs, transfers and batch transfers, FX, and webhooks. Supporting developer tooling includes scoped API keys, OAuth partner connections, a separate sandbox, typed server-side SDKs, and a CLI, and an llms.txt index confirmed by probe makes the docs easy for agents to consume. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented (all evidence is first-party, and the server-side SDKs are labeled beta).
